text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT firing: latency_slo_burn_eu-west-1 (p99 > 18s) — affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/alerts/5421

pagerduty: Incident created: PD-98431 — severity: high. Pager oncall: maria. Link: https://pd.internal/incidents/PD-98431

maria: acked in PD-98431 — I'm on it. Saw spike at 12:47 UTC. p95 ~ 1.9s but p99 headroom shot to 22s for a subset of customers in eu-west.

sam: jumping in — checking autoscaler logs and nodepool activity. My quick read: k8s cluster couldn't allocate new GPU nodes due to cloud quota error at 12:46:17.

alex: noted. runtime traces show persistent KV cache evictions around the same time, cache thrash + sudden batch growth. Likely combo: sudden burst of long-context requests + no capacity to spin GPUs.

maria: customer impact — multiple enterprise tenants in eu-west seeing timeouts and degraded throughput. CS pinged: @jen — can you surface an impact note to the support channel?

jen: yes, pushing an in-product banner and opening a ticket for the affected orgs. Drafted message: "We're investigating elevated inference latency in EU; mitigation in progress. Will update in ~15m."

sam: logs snippet from autoscaler:
```
2026-03-14T12:46:16Z ERROR allocator: failed to create node: quotaExceeded: requested 8 gpus, available 0
2026-03-14T12:46:17Z WARN scaler: scale_event_rejected reason=QuotaExceeded
```

alex: runtime tail of one worker showing heavy OOM-ish behaviour (not exact OOM) and KV eviction churn:
```
[2026-03-14 12:46:24] kvcache eviction: prefix=conv-42 size=128kb -> evict
[2026-03-14 12:46:25] attention_kernel latency=120ms seq=1024
[2026-03-14 12:46:25] request: model=redwood-small seq_len=2048 tokens=1800
```

sam: mitigation plan executed: 1) swapped routing for eu-west to fallback model family (redwood-small-quant) for non-enterprise traffic, 2) manually scaled dedicated fallback nodepool (attempting add via cloud console), 3) applied tenant throttling for low-priority keys. Commands run:
```
kubectl apply -f /ops/manifests/eviction-protector.yaml
kubectl scale nodepool eu-west-fallback --replicas=4
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/ops/throttle -d '{"labels": ["free-tier"], "rate": "0.5"}'
```

maria: outcome so far: p99 dropped from ~22s to ~7.5s after routing change + tenant throttling. Some enterprise tenants still seeing elevated tails — working with infra to get nodes up.

dinesh: I can confirm cloud quota request is pending with infra billing team. I've opened support case with cloud provider (case #CP-77522). Estimated approval ~ 25-40m. Meanwhile we should keep fallback routing.

alex: also enabling KV cache warmup for the fallback model to reduce cold-start token costs. Patch applied to routing lambda at 12:52.

sam: manual node add succeeded (partial) at 12:54:02 — 2 GPUs came up, scheduler placed some long requests there. Still below desired capacity (requested 8). Triggering autoscaler retry and forcing pending pods to preempt less-critical ones.

maria: PD incident note: "Root cause: cluster quota prevented autoscaler from adding required GPU capacity, combined with a burst of long-context requests causing KV cache thrash and elevated p99 latency. Mitigations: fallback routing to quantized model, tenant throttling, manual nodepool scale, cache warmup. Cloud quota request opened."

jen: posted customer update to support and added list of affected org ids. Attaching updated status to PD-98431.

pagerduty: PD-98431 updated: assigned to maria, escalated to oncall-2 after 30m if unresolved.

maria: handing off to @dinesh for next shift/handoff. I'll stay available for 10m then mark incident for follow-up doc. Key follow-ups: 1) add autoscaler quota preflight check to avoid hard failures, 2) improve cold KV cache warmup, 3) add per-tenant backpressure knob in routing, 4) run replay to validate fallback routes.

dinesh: ack — taking over incident at 12:59 UTC. Will coordinate postmortem and include timeline + action owners. tagging: @sam (infra) for quota preflight, @alex (runtime) for cache warmup improvements, @jen (support) for customer comms.

maria: thanks team. closing this thread for live mitigation; will open a dedicated postmortem doc and link to PD-98431. :white_check_mark:
